title: Pebble and Flicker's Moon Puddle
markdown:
The moon, a big soft circle, smiled down on the sleepy trees. Silver shadows played hide-and-seek on the ground. By the Willow Whispers stream, where the water sang a bubbly lullaby, Pebble the puppy and Wisp the woodmouse played.

Pebble’s tail went thump-thump-thump on the grass. A happy sound. Wisp sat still, twinkly-eyed, glad to watch.

Then Pebble lifted his floppy ears.

A tiny lantern fish bobbed in the water. His little light was dim. He gave tiny watery sighs.

“Oh my,” whispered Wisp. “That must be Flicker. He looks so sleepy.”

Pebble’s warm heart felt a flutter. He liked to help. “We must help him.”

Wisp nodded. “Yes. We must help Flicker find his home. The moon puddle is where he belongs.”

Wisp told Pebble about the moon puddle. A small round place in a smooth stone. Water that shimmered like held moonbeams. A cozy bed for a sleepy lantern fish.

Very gently, Wisp found a big soft leaf. Smooth. Green. It smelled like sweet rain. Pebble nudged Flicker onto the leaf with his soft nose. Flicker’s little light grew a little brighter.

“To the moon puddle,” Wisp whispered. “Where the water sings to sleepy friends.”

They padded along, carrying the leaf so carefully. Leaves overhead whispered. The breeze smelled like clover.

Pebble loved to wiggle and run. He wanted to pounce. As they walked past tall reeds that rustled like little green dancers, Pebble gave a happy hop.

The leaf wobbled. Flicker’s light flickered.

Pebble stopped. He saw the light. He remembered Wisp’s slow way. He sat down. His bouncy feeling calmed, like a soft cloud.

“Oh, Flicker,” he whispered. “I am sorry. I will be calm. You are safe. We will go very, very slow.”

He nudged the leaf again, ever so slow. His tail gave a gentle wag.

Wisp patted Pebble’s paw. “You are doing so well.”

They walked on. The path felt smooth and quiet. Soon, through the soft moonlight, they saw it. A little round pool in a stone. Water like a piece of the sky.

The moon puddle.

With great care they set the leaf by the water. When the leaf touched, Flicker’s light grew bright, then brighter. He wiggled with joy and slid in. His light danced like a tiny star. He circled once. He settled with a happy sigh. The water sang its bubbly song.

Pebble and Wisp watched. Their hearts felt warm. Pebble felt a quiet happy, like moonlight in his chest. Wisp’s eyes held the puddle’s shine.

“All is well,” Wisp whispered.

The moon was high now, a big silver friend. The world was quiet. Pebble yawned a big sleepy yawn. His floppy ears drooped. Wisp curled close. They snuggled in the soft grass, listening to the stream, and to Flicker’s happy light, twinkling in the moon puddle.

The sleepy stars blinked open. Pebble and Wisp drifted off, safe and warm, their dreams full of soft moonlight and one small happy light.
characters: Pebble (a puppy), Flicker (a lantern fish), Wisp (a woodmouse)
author: StoryGen Community
